notes: SUPPLY LINES - WAR! battles now pause, save and resume mid-fight: the corner X opens a menu with Resume, Restart Battle and Save & Quit, and a battle in progress rides along in your game save. Richer fields (250 starting bits, nine code nodes, harvesters carry 25) and smashed debris pays salvage bits. Units and bugs pathfind around walls; new Gates on the Defense shelf let your army through and make the bugs stop and chew; training queues stack nine deep per building, paid up front; rally points send fresh troops where you tap; and the command bar is sorted into Train, Build and Defense. Super Buddy Run is a touch slower, and its pipe piranha bugs are visible again on touch and split-screen.
